tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i gter mdzod bzhugs so// oṃ bde legs su gyur cig dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i gter mdzod zhes bya ba/ bla ma mchog dang khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir mdo rgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi brjod bya'i snying po mthar thug pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi nyams bzhes kyi nying khu/ skal ldan gyi 'gro ba tshe gcig lus gcig la zung 'jug gi sar bgrod pa'i sgo gcig pu ni lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid yin la/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyi phyir na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mchod pa'i cho ga lag tu blangs pa'i tshul gsal bar brjod par bya ste/ de yang dus kyi khyad par nang nub la sogs pa rgyun du bya ba'am/ mchog tu phan yon gyi 'gyur ches che ba ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i dus chen bzhi/ dus chung bzhi la sogs pa dang / rang nyid kyi chos 'brel thob pa'i bla ma zhing gzhan du gshegs pa yod na de'i dus dang / zla ba gcig gi nya stong dang / brgyad gnyis la sogs pa'i dus kyi tshe/ gnas khang dben zhing yid du 'ong bar chag chag dang byi dor legs par byas/ steng du zab chen la sogs pa'i bla re bris/ phyogs mtshams rnams su ras dang dar la sogs pa'i yol ba bkrams/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / lda ldi dang / rin po che'i 'phreng ba'i tshar tshar la sogs pa'i mdzes par byas/ de dag gi gung ngos su sa stegs sam/ shing la sogs pa'i stegs bu rim pa gang 'os brtan zhing mtho ba'i steng du/ spyir dkon mchog gi brten gang yod dang / khyad par gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i sku 'bag gser sku la sogs pa zhugs su gsol/ gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i bris sku lta bu yod na'ang dgram par bya'o/ /de'i drung du dkon mchog spyi'i mchod pa bzang zhing rgya che ba bye brag tu bla ma brgyud pa re re la'ang sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga tshan pa bcu re'am/

mtha' na re re bshams/ khyad par du rtsa ba'i bla ma la mchod pa brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig gam/ tha na'ang bcu las mi nyung ba bshams/ gser dngul 'khar ba la sogs pa'i maṇḍal yongs su dag pa rin po che 'am tsandan lta bu'i gling bzhi la sogs gzugs rnyan 'bur dod du bskos pa/ tshom bur byed na de'i chas 'bras dkar po'am nas dkar po'am sa rdo sbun sogs ye med pa dri bzang gi lde gu dang bcas pa/ nyin re tsam la ni mar dang thud la sogs pa la tshom bu'i dod byas pa'ang yod/ gzhan yang rten khebs la sogs pa'i dar zab kyi na za'i bye brag rnga dang / cha lang dang / ting ting shag dang / dung dkar la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang / dkar gsum dngar gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' ba dang bca' ba dang / btung ba dang / rgun 'brum dang / khams bu la sogs pa'i shing tog sna tshogs dang / ja/ bu ram/ gser dngul gyi dam phor/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba'i bye brag sogs ji snyed de dag thams cad rgyu bzang shing bkod pa mdzes pa/ gzhan gyi mthong na dad pa skye zhing blor 'tshams pa lta bu dang / rang nyid kyis bltas na 'byor ba'i yo byad gang yod mchod par phul ba lta bu/ rgya che zhing dngos gtsang ba grangs mang zhing bkod pa mang bar bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams khrus byas rang rang tshul dang mthun pa'i rgyan gos gsar pa rnams kyis brgyan nas/ dar zab la sogs pa'i stan la rten la kha phyogs par 'dug pa'i mdun du cog tse la sogs pa'i steng du/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ me tog gis phud bu la sogs bshams/ 'di dag gi skabs su mchod pa rnams rgyu ngan zhing dngos po chung ba grangs nyung ba gya tshoms su bkod pa sogs byas na 'phral phugs kyi rten 'brel mang po 'chugs pas tshul 'di la snying stobs skyed cing sla chos su ma song ba ci nas gal che'o/ /dngos bzhi cho ga la/ spyir so so'i bzhed tshul rnam grangs mang na yang / rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi phyag len la/

gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag mchod 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa/ gzhung gi tshul du byas nas kha skang ba'i phyag len dang / bde mchog bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag mchod chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa dang / grub thob bhu'u ri pas mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags sbyar ba'i lag len gnyis gtso bor mdzad pa las/ 'dir dang po nyams su len pa'i tshul gyi lag len dang / ngag 'don gyi rim pa ni 'di ltar/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge mdun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro tshar bdun nam nyer gcig la sogs pa brjod/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyi byang chub mchog tu sems skyed/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur gcig sdug bsngal dbang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces tshar gcig gis tshad med bzhi bsgoms/ de nas rten skyed pa la/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor chung ngu gnyis kyi don khang gsar ba ti shrī grags pa 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod chog 'di nyid brtsom snga zhing grags che bas phyis kyi bla ma rnams 'dir 'byung ba'i thun mong gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang du skyed pa'i cho ga tshig sna ring thung ci rigs bsgyur nas mdzad par snang mod/

'dir ni las dang po pa rnams 'jug pa bde zhing rnam pa gsal ba'i phyir bla ma'i skyed chog rtsa ba'i bla ma la yon tan dang bka' drin gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul kho bos brjod par bya ste/ phun tshogs srid zhi'i dge legs ma lus pa/ /gang gi sprul pa'i rang sems gdod ma'i gshis/ /gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' bral ba/ /'od gsal bde ba chen po'i rnam rol las/ /rab 'jigs rdo rje'i gur khang 'bar ba'i nang / /yid 'ong nor bu'i gzhal med khang chen po/ /kun bzang mchod sprin gsar pa'i phang phung gi /nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khyab pa'i dbus/ /gdong lngas btegs pa'i yid bzhin nor bu'i khrir/ /'jam mnyen rnam bkra'i pañtsa li kas spras/ /chu skyes 'dab rgyas ze'u 'brur nyi gzhon dang / /zla shel 'dzum phreng rgod pa'i lte bar ni/ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus drin can rdo rings pa/ /gdan gsum tshang ba'i ded dpon he ru ka /smin grol lam ston rdo rje slob dpon mchog /sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang / /'od gsal ston gyi nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog /nyin byed bye ba'i gzi 'bar lang tsho'i dpal/ /bdag la dgyes shing brtse ba'i 'dzum dkar bzhad/ /mig sman mdog can ral pa'i zur phud g.yo/ /phyag gnyis gser bzang rdo rje rtse lnga dang / /dngul dkar dril bu thugs dkar 'khyud rgyas 'dzin/ /nor bu'i rgyan dang dar zab lhab lhub mdzes/ /rdo rje skyil krung sgeg cing 'gying ba'i nyams/ /gang sku mthong bas dga' bde'i spu long g.yo/ /gang gsung thos pas snying gi gdung ba 'phrog /gang thugs dran pas srid bzhi'i 'jigs las sgrol/ /bka' drin mnyam med drin can chos rje de'i/ /gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi gzugs can ni/ /oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing yig 'bru'i dbyibs/ /dwang ba'i chu nang zla shel 'char ba ltar/ /gsal ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/

/khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang nas gzung ste/ /'phags yul grub dbang rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam dkyil 'khor rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo mthu ldan srungs ma'i tshogs/ /mkha' la 'char dang sa la na bun dang / /phyogs mtshams brgyad nas sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar/ /byon nas rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gnyis med thim shing mtha' skor kun tu yang / /til gyi gang bu phye ba ji bzhin du/ /dgyes shing 'dzum pas mngon sum bzhugs par gyur/ /ces brjod pa'i rjes su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pas gtso mdzad/ skyabs yul rnams mngon sum bzhin bzhugs pa'i drung du/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad lus re re'ang zhing gi rdul snyed mnyam par sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang / yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas byang chub ma thob bar du khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang ldan pas yan lag lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag 'tshal zhing / bdag dang nam mkha' mtha' klas 'gro ba rnams/ /deng nas zung 'jug go 'phang ma thob bar/ /mgon po khyod las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas/ /sgo gsum gus pas snying nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs mkhyen brtse'i 'od chags yid bzhin dbang / /skal bzang dad pa'i gtsug gi rgyal mtshan rtser/ /mchod pa'i mod la 'dod dgu sbyin pa'i dpal/ /rje btsun dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod sku mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar 'od stong can/ /mthong ba'i mod la yid kyi mun sel zhing / /snying gi padmo bzhad pa'i dpal ster ba/ /rje btsun nyin byed dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod gsung zab dang rgya che'i sprin gyi sgra/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal 'od bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /skal bzang blo yi 'dzin mar 'bebs mkhas pa'i/ /rje btsun dam chos sprin sngon la phyag 'tshal/

/khyod thugs bde ba chen po'i sprin lam las/ /brtse 'dzin 'dzum dkar bzhad pa'i zla shel 'od/ /dad ldan snying gi ku mud kha 'byed pa'i/ /rje btsun mtshan mo'i mgon po la phyag 'tshal/ /gang gi yon tan chu gter chen po'i dbyings/ /gting zab pha mtha' sus kyang mi rtogs shing / /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'khrul kun gyi mdzod/ /brje btsun yon tan rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas don ldan zhing / /yun du bsten na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub thams cad bde blag stsol mdzad pa'i/ /brje btsun 'phrin las dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba la/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gzings chen rab bskyod nas/ /bde chen thar pa'i skam sar 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun ded dpon chen po la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod zhabs dran zhing gsol ba btab pa'i mod/ /mi mthun phyogs kun dus mtha'i me dpung dang / /'phrad pa'i bud shing lta bur 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun mthu stobs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /khams gsum mun nag chen po'i nags khrod du/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i nyin byed khyod shar tshe/ /mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i 'gro kun gyi/ /mun sel bstan pa'i sgron me la phyag 'tshal/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams na bdag po yis/ /gzung dang ma gzung mchod rdzas ji snyed dang / /dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bdag lus longs spyod bcas pa gus pas 'bul/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub tshogs rnams kun/ /gegs med bde blag 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces dang / rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang thob pa yin na/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma la gdan gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas thun mong ma yin pa'i bstod pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/

/ces pa nas/ khyod mnyes bgyid pa'ang thob par shog /bla ma dam pa la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgo nas bstod pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o/ /gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i gang zag gis tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa chad pa ma mthong ngo / /dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob nas bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la tshul 'di lta bu'i sgo nas bstod do/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod par 'gyur bas rten 'brel rang 'grig tu 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin no// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i tshul khrims ldan/ /gsung gi 'phrin las phun sum tshogs/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus khyab/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rab zab pa/ /chos rnams kun gyi de nyid mkhyen/ /mkhas pa thams cad dga' mdzad pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la mnga'/ /sems can thams cad smin mdzad pa'i/ /'phrin las mnga' ba chos kyi rje/ /khyod la bsu bas dpal du byed/ /brten pas blo gros mchog tu 'gyur/ /bsten na 'jigs pa med par mdzad/ /bsnyen bskur bgyis pas bde ba 'byung / /de 'dra'i dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /bla ma mchog la bdag gsol 'debs/ /mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma mchod par gsungs so zhes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /de bas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par byed par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan/ /ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /de srid bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ /'bral ba med par gnas gyur cig /mchod pa kun gyi mchod byed cing / /dam chos rtag tu nyan pa dang / /bka' bzhin sgrub pa'ang byed par shog /ces brjod/

de nas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'i lam 'bras phyag mchod dngos la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams lang la shlau ka re re'i mtshams su phyag bya zhing / mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rjer ldan pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yab/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bla ma sogs nas/ brag phug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams mthar phyin mkhas pa'i dbus/ /rgyal mtshan tog ltar cher mtho ba'i/ /grub dbang dpal ldan bla ma rje/ /yongs 'dzin bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i blo gros kyis/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs bzung nas/ /'gro ba'i dpal mgon mchog gyur pa/ /mdzad pa bzang po la phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog de la/ /lam bzang rdo rje theg pa ma lus gsan/ /chos kyi nyi mas rang gzhan smin mdzad pa'i/ /kun spangs chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /sogs shlau ka lnga'i rjes su/ blo gsal gdul bya'i sa chen skyong / /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbus na brjid/ /rim gnyis nor bu'i cod paṇa 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /yang na bdag chen rdo rje 'chang man chad kyi bstod pa kho bos sbyar ba 'di nyid brjod kyang rung ste/ ri bo rtse lngar 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dpal ldan sa skya snying po'i zhabs/ /dbyer med bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /blo gros rgyal mtshan la phyag mtshal/ /au ḍi ya nar 'byor ba'i dbang / /kun bzang nags khrod phag gru pa/ /kha'u'i brag rdzong rdo ring pa/ /bka' drin mnyam med la phyag 'tshal/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs thugs la zhugs/ /'khor 'das dbyer med rang zhal gzigs/ /snyan brgyud gdams pas skal ldan skyong / /tshar pa chos rje la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes sogs dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /sogs nas/ yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod/

/yan gyi phyi mchod dang / dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /sogs shlau ka gcig gi nang mchod/ sgrib pa'i dri ma sogs shlau ka gcig gis ni gsang ba bde stong zung 'jug pa'i mchod pa yin/ zhes bla ma 'ga' zhig gsung ngo / /mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ kyai rdor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na de nas bshad pa ltar bya zhing / thun mong du yo ga ltar mdzad pas/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bsal/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma dag pa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa nam mkha' thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/ de nas tshigs bcad kyi dus lag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar pad skor dang / rang rang gi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol tog pa dang bcas pa bya zhing / rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang / /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / de bzhin du tshigs bcad sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ me tog ji snyed༞

puṣpe༞ gdug spos dang / dhu pe༞ snang gsal dang / ā lo ke༞ dri chab dang / gandhe༞ zhal zas dang / nai wi dya༞ rol mo ji snyed yod pa dang / oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wa ra/ zhes sogs rol chen bya zhing / oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs/ yang na/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing / /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu dgram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ /ces sogs dang / yang na/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /zhes sogs dang / yang na/ zhing khams rgya mtsho ma sogs/ de gsum char gyi sngags kyi sbyar tshul gong dang 'dra'o/ /rgyas shing spros pa la dga' na/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa'ang bya ste/ rang gi snying kha nas rig ma bcu drug dpag tu med pa spros la/ de rnams kyis bla ma 'khor bcas mchod par bsam shing / so so'i phyag rgya rnams byas la/ dbang sngon mdog mtshungs rdo rje pi waṃ ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma pi waṃ sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wa ra oṃ badzra wi ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / de bzhin du rkang pa bar ma gnyis thams cad la 'dra bar sbyar la/ gser zangs mdog mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma gling bu'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ badzra wā se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ padma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rdza rnga ma/ /sna tshogs dgos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma rdza rnga'i sgra yis mchod/ /oṃ badzra mṛ daṃ ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga zlum ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma rnga zlum sgra yis mchod/ oṃ badzra mu rañdze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ li khri'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje bzhad pa ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma bzhad pa'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ badzra ha sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje sgeg mo ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma sgeg mdzes bde bas mchod/ /oṃ badzra lā sye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gur gum mdog mtshungs rdo rje glu len ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma snyan pa'i glu yi mchod/ /oṃ badzra gīrti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pri ya'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje gar mkhan ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma mdzes pa'i gar gyis mchod/ /oṃ badzra nri tye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zla ba'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje me tog ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma me tog sil mas mchod/ /oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ind+ra ni la'i mdog mtshungs gdug spos ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma bdug spos sprin gyis mchod/ /oṃ badzra dhū pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi ma'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje mar me ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma mar me'i 'phreng bas mchod/ /oṃ badzra dī paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sindhu'i mdog mtshungs rdo rje dri chab ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma dri bzang byug pas mchod/ /oṃ badzra gandhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chu shel mdog mtshungs gzugs kyi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/

/nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma gzugs mdzes bde bas mchod/ /oṃ rū pa badzri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsod kyi mdog mtshungs ro yi rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma ro yi bde bas mchod/ /oṃ rā sa badzri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sna tshogs mdog mtshungs reg bya rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs༞ /nam mkha'༞ /dpal ldan bla ma reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ /oṃ sparshe badzre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ston zla'i mdog mtshungs chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sna tshogs gos dang rgyan gyis rab mdzes ma/ /nam mkha' gang bar sems kyis rab sprul nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma chos khams bde bas mchod/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra sū ra sū ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ zhes pas rin chen sna bdun sprul la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /sogs nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ gu ru buddha bodhi satwa sa pa ri wa ra tsakra ratna pū dzi te swā hā/ zhes brjod pa sogs rigs 'gre/ de nas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ /sogs nas/ sparshe/ zhes pa yan gyi mchod/ maṇḍal 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ rgyan sum cu so bdun rin po che las grub pa'am/ mar thud la sogs pa la gzos pa bkod kyang rung ste/ mchod g.yog pas lag pa g.yon pas maṇḍal gzung g.yas pas spos rengs thogs te/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab nas/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol gyi bar dang / gang gis mchod rdzas/ zhing khams rgya mtsho/ /zhes sogs nas/ oṃ gu ru buddha bodhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas maṇḍal phul/ de nas sdig bshags sogs bya ba ni/

bdag ni thog med dus nas su/ /sogs nas/ ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog gi bar/ de nas rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab par bsam la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin bshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa sogs/ dngos po thams cad kyi bla ma dam pa mnyes par byas te sogs/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par byin gyi brlabs tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab/ de nas 'khor rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma la rim gyis thim/ bla ma rang gi spyi bor bsams la/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor padmo'i gdan bzhugs la/ /bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ snying padma 'dab brgyad du gsal ba'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bzhugs pa/ rang nyid kyi thos sogs kyi yon tan gyis mchod par bsam la/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchood yon kun nas 'khyil/ /sogs nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig /ces pas mchod la/ slar yang gsol ba 'deb pa ni/ sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi yis grur zhugs te/ /shin tu brgal dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis/ /bde chen thar pa'i gnas su drang du gsol/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gcong rong nang zhugs pa'i/ /skye ba'i chu bo bzlog par dka' mod kyang / /las kyi dbang gis dmyal ba myong na yang / /dam pa khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so/ /zhes pas gsol ba btab/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo dbang gi rgyal po ltar sogs/ de nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ tshig ci shes kyi gsol ba btab na legs la/ bsdu na de'i rjes su/ bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gang gi mtshan yang bgrang yas bskal pa'i bar/

/rnyed par dka' ba'i rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /tshar pa chos rje'i zhabs pad bsten par shog /ces sogs skabs su bab cing 'brel chags pa'i smon lam yid ches par btab pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med birwa pa/ /zhes sogs kyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa du ma brjod cing / rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma mchod pa 'di nyid kyi rig ma bcu drug 'bul ba yan chad pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas mdzad de/ cung ma grub pa'i mtshams su/ rje bla ma dam pa'i thugs kyi sras rdo rje mchod po bdo mkhar ba rin po ches gnang sbyin dang bcas te bkas bskul ba dang / mdar nas sde pa rin po che yab yum rnams kyis kyang bka' gnang ba'i ngor ban rgan mkhyen brtses/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid kyi gsung bgros dang phyag len ji lta bar sgrigs nas phul ba 'dis kyang / sems can thams cad la bla ma dam pa'i byin brlabs 'jug par gyur cig/ ༈ /nā ma gu ra we/ rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med birwa pa/ /nag po pa dang ḍā ma ru pa dang / /a wa dhu ti ga ya dha ra'i zhabs/ /'phags yul gsung ngag brgyud pa'i bkra shis shog /bla chen 'brog mi se ston sag thang pa/ /sa chen kun snying rje btsun sku mched gnyis/ /sa skya paṇa chen chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /bod yul bstan pa'i bdag po'i bkra shis shog /zhang ston chos rje grub chen brag phug pa/ /chos rje bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ buddha shrī dpal ldan ngor pa'i zhabs/ /gsung ngag bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mkhas grub rgyal sras dbang po mus chen pa/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa/ /snyan brgyud slob bshad 'dzin pa'i kha'u pa/ /drin can bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag kyai rdo rje/ /dam chos rgya mtsho'i nying khu gsung ngag mchog /bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan sa skya pa/

/mchog gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i bkra shis shog /bstan bsrungs kun gyi ded dpon rdo rje gur/ /bstan 'dzin bu ltar skyong ba'i 'dod khams ma/ /bstan dgra'i gshed ma zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa/ /bstan bsrungs rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /'dod dgu'i mchog sbyin rje btsun rig byed ma/ /'dod yon char 'bebs lha chen tshogs kyi bdag /'dod pa'i rgyal po khams gsum dbang sdud lha/ /'dod don bde blag 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'i shis brjod kyi 'phreng ba 'di'ang bandhe blo gsal gyis sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dngos grub rin po che'i gter mdzod/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
